title: LightGBM guides discovery of argyrodite lithium-ion conductors
summary: A composition-based LightGBM model trained on about 4,000 compounds guided synthesis of co-substituted argyrodite families. The primary paper reports Li6.7Ge0.595Si0.105P0.3S5I conductivity of 7.2×10−3 S cm−1 and a separate hot-pressed conductivity above 10−2 S cm−1. These are material measurements, not a demonstrated full battery; the model did not originate the argyrodite family.

evidence.tested: Publisher full-text indexed article identifies LightGBM screening and specific synthesized conductor conductivity results.
evidence.unknown: Prior composition reports and detailed processing/test comparisons remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Composition-based model estimates ionic conductivity and guides synthesis of co-substituted candidates.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
